description: Cross-cutting NotesTab wiring + full-task verification. steps: Edit src/components/pages/character/NotesTab.tsx: pass onRoll={addRoll} to the existing <CorruptionCard ... /> render (DiseasePanel already receives onRoll={addRoll}; leave it unchanged). No other change to NotesTab.

acceptance_criteria: NotesTab passes onRoll={addRoll} to CorruptionCard and NotesTab tests pass unchanged.

No pre-existing test was modified to pass; the change is additive (NFR-2).
